lines.say: My regular stopped coming in. So I assumed he died. I'm not proud of this.
I ordered forty flowers. I booked a church. I hired a guy to play the organ.
Two hundred people came. I gave the eulogy. I said he had the best haircut in Georgia. A kid fainted.
caps: I gave the eulogy. A kid fainted.

lines.say: Comment KEEP if you've ever buried a client who was still alive.
caps: buried a client who was alive.

lines.say: Then the church doors open. And Terrell walks in. Eating a sandwich.
caps: Terrell walks in, eating a sandwich.

lines.say: He goes, bro, who died? Then he asks if I've got time for a lineup.
He wasn't dead. He'd been going to another barber for two months. Nobody ever texted him.
caps: for two months. Nobody texted him.

lines.say: Two hundred mourners. Forty flowers. An organ guy. And I never sent one text.
So now I use Message Health. It spots who's gone quiet, and texts them for me. Week three, not month two.
